record.paper_title: Some Open Problems in the Theory of Singularities of Mappings
record.original_question: Let f: (C^n,0) -> (C^(n+1),0) be finite and generically one-to-one. Let M_j(f) be the target multiple-point space determined by the Fitting ideal construction, and suppose dim M_j(f)=n+1-j for every j with 0<=j<=k. Under these hypotheses, is O_{Y,0}/F_k(f_*O_X) Cohen-Macaulay?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 3.1. Let f : (Cn, 0) -> (Cn+1, 0) be finite and generically 1-1, and suppose that dim Mj(f) = n + 1 - j for 0 <= j <= k. Then OY,0 /Fk(f* OX)) is Cohen Macaulay.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $f\colon (\mathbb{C}^n,0)\to(\mathbb{C}^{n+1},0)$ be a finite, generically one-to-one holomorphic map-germ. Denote by $X=(\mathbb{C}^n,0)$ and $Y=(\mathbb{C}^{n+1},0)$, and let $f_*\mathcal O_X$ be the direct image of the structure sheaf, viewed as a coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module. For each integer $k\ge 0$, let $F_k(f_*\mathcal O_X)$ denote the $k$-th Fitting ideal of $f_*\mathcal O_X$ in $\mathcal O_{Y,0}$, and define the $k$-th target multiple-point space by
$$M_k(f) := V(F_k(f_*\mathcal O_X)) \subset (Y,0),$$
endowed with the analytic structure given by $\mathcal O_{M_k(f),0} = \mathcal O_{Y,0}/F_k(f_*\mathcal O_X)$.

Suppose that for some integer $k\ge 0$ we have the dimension equalities
$$\dim M_j(f) = n+1-j \qquad \text{for every } j \text{ with } 0 \le j \le k.$$

Question: Under these hypotheses, is the local analytic algebra $\mathcal O_{Y,0}/F_k(f_*\mathcal O_X)$ Cohen–Macaulay?
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture is due to Mond and concerns Cohen–Macaulayness of multiple-point schemes defined via Fitting ideals for finite, generically 1-1 corank-1 type maps from $\mathbb{C}^n$ to $\mathbb{C}^{n+1}$. Standard results of Mond–Pellikaan establish the case $k=0$ (the image), and special cases (small $n$, low $k$, corank 1) are known, but no general proof appears in the literature; web/arXiv searches surface no resolution and the problem is still listed as a conjecture in surveys of open problems on singularities of mappings.

status_evidence.title: Fitting ideals and multiple points of analytic mappings
status_evidence.snippet: Mond–Pellikaan establish the Fitting-ideal description of the image and base cases for multiple-point schemes.
status_evidence.claim: The base case k=0 of the Cohen–Macaulay statement (image is Cohen–Macaulay) is due to Mond–Pellikaan; higher k remains conjectural.

status_evidence.title: Multiple point spaces and finitely determined map-germs
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses multiple point spaces of finitely determined map-germs and Cohen–Macaulay properties in particular cases.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent work treats only special situations, with the general Cohen–Macaulay conjecture left open.
